title: CI diet: free the GitHub-hosted runner pool for research without weakening any check (data-only PRs run only the tests that read their paths)
note: [2026-10-13 lane CI-DIET] MEASURED over the 48h ending 20:18Z (9,500 runs from the Actions API; job-minutes sampled 6 runs/workflow): PR pytest-run is ~62% of CI job-minutes (502 runs, mean ~36 job-min, ~17.9k min/48h); Guards PR ~2.3k, Guards push ~1.5k, pytest-run push ~1.7k (200 pushes), everything else <1k each. 179 of 233 commits landed on main (77%) touched ONLY research/queue|results, checklist, pipeline, comms, pr-landing/automerge/merge-slot files, yet every one paid the full suite on the PR and again on push (the relevance filter includes those trees because tests read them). FIX 1 (this PR): scripts/ci/pytest_run_scope.py + pytest-run.yml: a data-only diff runs the 249 test files that mention those trees instead of the full suite; non-allowlisted path => full; guards unchanged; check name unchanged. Concurrency-cancel already exists on every PR workflow (3.3k min/48h are partial runs cancelled by newer pushes). NOT changed on purpose: Guards --all on push (post-merge semantic-skew net), push pytest-run for code merges.
